caption: The drawing depicts a weather vane with a cow figure mounted on top. The cow is rendered in muted brown and greenish hues with some subtle highlights, positioned in profile facing to the left. Below the cow, there is a horizontal platform or bar, which is connected to a spherical element at the intersection with a vertical rod. Four large letters—"W," "E," "N," and "S"—each colored yellow with a metallic sheen, are arranged around the vertical rod, indicating the cardinal directions west, east, north, and south, respectively. The vertical rod extends downward with a pointed or finned tip. The weather vane structure is centrally placed within a large rectangular border on a light, nearly white background. In the lower right corner, there is a small schematic drawing, also in plain lines, showing a simple diagram of the weather vane’s structure and orientation. The objects are illustrated with attention to metallic texture and realistic proportions, while the overall color palette is dominated by earth tones and metallic shades.
title: Weather Vane
